author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_reaudit2.rs::divergence_deep_nested_loop_no_panic and ::divergence_deep_nested_while_no_panic demonstrate the divergence. The #31 fix (f0ceb12) routed parse_expr/parse_type/parse_pattern/parse_if_parts through guard_recursion, but the loop-body cycle parse_block -> parse_loop (Loop/While arm) -> parse_block (line 770) routes through NEITHER guard. 1500-deep 'loop inv true dec 0 { ... }' and 'while true inv true dec 0 { ... }' both SIGABRT (signal 6) on a 2 MiB stack. Authority: parser.md AC-4 (no input causes a panic) + surface-grammar.md REQ-3 (loop/while body is a Block, nested loops are well-formed v0.1 grammar). Control test control_deep_nested_if_stmt_returns PASSES, confirming the statement-if path IS bounded (via guarded parse_if_parts) — the gap is loops only. Root cause: guard_recursion must wrap the parse_loop body re-entry (or parse_block) in the owning crate.
